/**
 * The Table tab of the T20 World Cup: one table per group (A to D), then one per Super 8 group once the
 * groups are over. Each table has a heading a screen reader can jump to.
 */
@Composable
internal fun WorldCupTableTab(state: TournamentState) {
    val tables = remember(state) { T20WorldCup.tables(state) }
    LazyColumn(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        item(key = "intro") {
            Text(
                text = "Two points for a win, one each for no result. The top two of each group of five go to the Super 8, " +
                    "and the top two of each Super 8 group go to the semi-finals.",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                modifier = Modifier.padding(bottom = 8.dp)
            )
        }
        tables.forEach { (title, rows) ->
            item(key = "title_$title") {
                Text(
                    text = title,
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge,
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .padding(top = 12.dp, bottom = 4.dp)
                        .semantics { heading() }
                )
            }
            item(key = "head_$title") {
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = 4.dp).semantics(mergeDescendants = true) {},
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)
                ) {
                    Text("#", modifier = Modifier.weight(0.5f), style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelLarge)
                    Text("Team", modifier = Modifier.weight(2.6f), style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelLarge)
                    Text("P", modifier = Modifier.weight(0.6f), style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelLarge)
                    Text("W", modifier = Modifier.weight(0.6f), style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelLarge)
                    Text("L", modifier = Modifier.weight(0.6f), style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelLarge)
                    Text("Pts", modifier = Modifier.weight(0.8f), style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelLarge)
                    Text("NRR", modifier = Modifier.weight(1.2f), style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelLarge)
                }
            }
            itemsIndexed(rows, key = { _, r -> title + r.team.id }) { index, r ->
                val nrr = (if (r.netRunRate >= 0) "+" else "") + String.format(java.util.Locale.US, "%.3f", r.netRunRate)
                val mine = r.team.id == state.userTeamId
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .padding(vertical = 6.dp)
                        .semantics(mergeDescendants = true) {},
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)
                ) {
                    Text("${index + 1}", modifier = Modifier.weight(0.5f))
                    Text(
                        text = CplData.shortName(r.team.id) + if (mine) " (you)" else "",
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(2.6f),
                        fontWeight = if (mine) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal
                    )
                    Text("${r.played}", modifier = Modifier.weight(0.6f))
                    Text("${r.won}", modifier = Modifier.weight(0.6f))
                    Text("${r.lost}", modifier = Modifier.weight(0.6f))
                    Text("${r.points}", modifier = Modifier.weight(0.8f), fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                    Text(nrr, modifier = Modifier.weight(1.2f))
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# T20 World Cup 2026 (patch 045)

The game's first international tournament: Tournament > International tournament > T20 World Cup 2026.

* **20 teams, 4 groups of 5** (A: India, Namibia, Netherlands, Pakistan, USA; B: Australia, Ireland, Oman,
  Sri Lanka, Zimbabwe; C: England, Italy, Nepal, Scotland, West Indies; D: Afghanistan, Canada,
  New Zealand, South Africa, UAE). Bangladesh did not play: Scotland replaced them, as in real life.
* **The 40 group matches are the real fixtures in the real order**, at the eight real grounds (Ahmedabad,
  Chennai, Delhi, Kolkata, Mumbai, Colombo x2, Kandy): all already in the game.
* **Super 8**: the top two of each group, in two groups of four (round-robin, no points carried over).
  The ICC's seeded places are used: Group 1 India, Australia, West Indies, South Africa; Group 2 Pakistan,
  Sri Lanka, England, New Zealand. A qualifying team takes its own seeded place; an unseeded team takes the
  place of a seeded team that did not qualify (as Zimbabwe took Australia's). Match order and grounds of the
  12 Super 8 matches are the real ones.
* **Semi-finals** (Eden Gardens, Wankhede): winner of Super 8 Group 1 v runner-up of Group 2, and winner of
  Group 2 v runner-up of Group 1. **Final** at Narendra Modi Stadium. (If the real tournament had put India
  in a different place, the venues would have changed; here they are fixed.)
* **Squads**: the final 2026 squads (15 to 18 players, replacements included). Players the game already
  had keep their ratings; 89 are new with ESTIMATED ratings (all of Namibia, Italy and Canada, and the
  players missing from the other associate squads). Only the Table tab shows a table per group.
* No overseas / breakout rules: any XI of 11 is allowed. Tags are all plain squad members.
* Points: 2 for a win, 1 for no result, ties settled by a Super Over; the table orders by points, wins, then
  net run rate (the ICC's later tie-breakers are not applied).
* Not built: the real results are not used (the game simulates them), rain rules, the Women's World Cup.
